estimates.rationale: Foundational stock row: new schema with unique (sku,location), boundary/service/repository/models layers, plus SPA file form + list/detail with empty state.
Reads established row but adds immutable timestamped/actor audit record, never-negative validation, and optimistic in-place row reconciliation in the SPA.
Additive receipt event (supplier + quantity) on the established stock row; straightforward form, confirmation, and field-named errors.
Outbound movement plus the hard invariant: transactional overcommit rejection with no double-allocation, both rejection and success paths observable in the SPA.

Single-table schema refactor on the F1 stock row: add batch/serial columns, delimiter-parse backfill of variable-width codes, drop the combined column, reversible down-path, plus an integrity probe surfacing nonconforming-row counts.
